flat.$description: No shadow — list rows, inline chips, anything inside a card. On dark surfaces use surface lightness steps instead.

raised.$description: Cards resting on screen — rgba(15,15,15,.06) shadow. Hex alpha: 0.06 × 255 = 15.3 ≈ 0F.

floating.$description: Tab bar, FAB, sticky CTA — rgba(15,15,15,.10) shadow. Hex alpha: 0.10 × 255 = 25.5 ≈ 1A.

overlay.$description: Sheets, modals, dropped panels — rgba(15,15,15,.16) shadow. Hex alpha: 0.16 × 255 = 40.8 ≈ 29.
